offline_replay.model: frozen CPU semi-implicit replay of recorded R11 qdot/M/Kp/Kd/dq0
offline_replay.selection_rule: Freeze global feedback_gain_scale=0.75 before R12 Isaac runs because the fixed proxy predicts all A/B/C below 0.25 mm with larger margin than 0.50; proxy is diagnostic only and no post-run tuning is allowed
variables: proxy global feedback scale in {1.0,0.75,0.75,0.25} applied to recorded pose-feedback qdot

single_runtime_change.scope: global common and relative pose feedback for every V10 cell

hard: joint position lookahead q+dt*qdot within original limits with 0.02 rad margin
soft: common virtual-object feedforward plus pose feedback
qp.solver: strict SPD box/equality QP via shifted affine equality and independent KKT

scope: R12 joint V10-A/B/C validation retaining R11 startup velocity capture and applying one globally frozen feedback-gain scale; unchanged safety and acceptance thresholds

selection.formal: disabled unless all V10-A/B/C and two independent diagnostics pass
selection.repeat: disabled unless all V10-A/B/C pass unchanged gates

virtual.initial_state: actual observed FREE_HOME ownership state; no teleport
